futureEvidenceOnly.claim: Magic Studio and Canva AI features belong to Canva; ordinary templates, Brand Kit and manual design are not themselves generative AI.
Standard/Premium/Ultra AI usage shares a complexity-dependent monthly allowance; actual plan, region, AI Pass, third-party app limits and export rights need account/design verification.
Canva Free Premium AI eligibility cannot be asserted: one help page says Free may use Premium allowance but also lists Premium eligibility under paid and special plans.

AI output may be used lawfully, subject to input rights and underlying Canva licensed content; Canva does not guarantee unique or copyrightable outputs. Free-account watermarks concern Pro library elements, not every AI output.

Privacy Settings govern use of user content for AI improvement; technology partners may process inputs to provide features. Apps inside Canva, REST APIs and assistant MCP are distinct integration surfaces; marketplace AI apps may have separate limits.
Canva AI 2.0 and Magic Layers are announced preview/beta features, not proven general availability to all plans and regions.

candidatePatch.value: For an existing marketing draft, an organization can assign brand tones and style rules so writers see tone, terminology and formatting suggestions. Pro lists one style guide and brand tone; Enterprise offers broader organization controls. Suggestions can be accepted or dismissed, website scope and enabled clients affect coverage, and style rule suggestions are unavailable in the Grammarly Keyboard. These are review aids, not mandatory approval or proof that an AI first draft automatically inherits organization rules. Verify the actual account and surface before relying on them. [Brand tones](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/4403544890253-Set-brand-tones) · [Style rules](https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043832652-Create-style-rules) · [Plans](https://www.grammarly.com/plans).
